title: Familiar Hull
text: The wreck is a lander, broken in two. Its frame uses our joint pattern, our bolt spacing, our hull alloy. The serial plate has been ground off. Archive: "No match on file." Nobody else was supposed to be here.

choices.label: Strip it for alloys
choices.reply: Logged as salvage. Field Engineers can take it apart.

choices.label: Scan the frame again
choices.reply: Second scan: the alloy matches our hull to four decimal places. Logged; no explanation on file.
